purpose: Exploratory matched-batching sensitivity analysis on previously inspected test data
stop_reason: Training did not start because importing installed PyTorch failed with Windows Application Control WinError 4551 while loading torch\lib\c10.dll. The bundled Codex Python runtime has no torch module. No packages were installed and no policy workaround was attempted.

configuration_audit.shared_architecture: 32 inputs; one-layer bidirectional LSTM, hidden size 64 each direction; shared 128-dimensional final-step representation; RUL head Linear(128,64)-ReLU-Linear(64,1)-Sigmoid; fault head Linear(128,64)-ReLU-Linear(64,4)
configuration_audit.stopping: Maximum 40 epochs; patience 8; gradient clipping 1.0; best checkpoint selected by validation total loss with improvement threshold 1e-8
configuration_audit.scaler: StandardScaler fit on recordings from the five training bearings only, then applied to validation and test

loader_shuffle.original_M2: training true; validation and test false
loader_shuffle.original_M3: training false; validation and test false
loader_shuffle.original_M4: training true; validation and test false
loader_shuffle.original_M5: training false; validation and test false
loader_shuffle.controls: training false; validation and test false

objectives.M4_and_M4_unshuffled: exp(-s_R)*MSE(RUL) + s_R + exp(-s_F)*CrossEntropy(fault) + s_F; no monotonicity term
objectives.M5: M4 adaptive objective + 0.1 * minibatch-local monotonicity loss

configuration_audit.control_isolation: The prepared runner reuses run_multiseed.run_multi and overrides only a true training-loader shuffle argument to false. Validation/test loaders remain false. No model or training configuration source was edited.
